mapper.sql: select cast(obj.name as nvarchar(128)) as table_name, isnull(cast(ep.value as nvarchar(500)), '') as table_comment, obj.create_date as create_time, obj.modify_date as update_time from sys.objects obj left join sys.extended_properties ep on obj.object_id = ep.major_id and ep.minor_id = 0 and ep.name = 'MS_Description' where obj.type = 'U' and obj.name != 'dtproperties'
mapper.select:
and lower(cast(obj.name as varchar(128))) like lower(concat('%', #{tableName}, '%'))
and lower(cast(ep.value as varchar(500))) like lower(concat('%', #{tableComment}, '%'))
order by obj.name

select cast(col.name as nvarchar(128)) as column_name, isnull(cast(ep.value as nvarchar(500)), '') as column_comment, cast(tp.name as nvarchar(128)) as data_type, case when col.max_length = -1 then -1 when tp.name in ('nvarchar', 'nchar', 'ntext') then col.max_length / 2 else col.max_length end as data_length, col.precision as data_precision, col.scale as data_scale, case when col.is_nullable = 1 then 'Y' else 'N' end as is_nullable, isnull(cast(dc.definition as nvarchar(500)), '') as column_default, case when col.is_identity = 1 then 'Y' else 'N' end as is_increment, case when exists ( select 1 from sys.indexes idx inner join sys.index_columns ic on ic.object_id = idx.object_id and ic.index_id = idx.index_id where idx.is_primary_key = 1 and ic.object_id = col.object_id and ic.column_id = col.column_id ) then 'Y' else 'N' end as is_pk, col.column_id as sort from sys.columns col left join sys.types tp on col.user_type_id = tp.user_type_id left join sys.extended_properties ep on ep.major_id = col.object_id and ep.minor_id = col.column_id and ep.name = 'MS_Description' left join sys.default_constraints dc on dc.parent_object_id = col.object_id and dc.parent_column_id = col.column_id where col.object_id = object_id(#{tableName}) order by col.column_id

select cast(fk.name as nvarchar(128)) as fk_name, cast(pt.name as nvarchar(128)) as table_name, cast(pc.name as nvarchar(128)) as column_name, cast(rt.name as nvarchar(128)) as ref_table_name, cast(rc.name as nvarchar(128)) as ref_column_name from sys.foreign_key_columns fkc inner join sys.foreign_keys fk on fkc.constraint_object_id = fk.object_id inner join sys.tables pt on fkc.parent_object_id = pt.object_id inner join sys.columns pc on fkc.parent_object_id = pc.object_id and fkc.parent_column_id = pc.column_id inner join sys.tables rt on fkc.referenced_object_id = rt.object_id inner join sys.columns rc on fkc.referenced_object_id = rc.object_id and fkc.referenced_column_id = rc.column_id where pt.name = #{tableName} or rt.name = #{tableName} order by fk.name, fkc.constraint_column_id

select cast(idx.name as nvarchar(128)) as index_name, cast(idx.type_desc as nvarchar(60)) as index_type, case when idx.is_primary_key = 1 then 'Y' else 'N' end as is_pk, case when idx.is_unique = 1 then 'Y' else 'N' end as is_unique, stuff(( select ',' + cast(ic_col.name as nvarchar(128)) from sys.index_columns ic inner join sys.columns ic_col on ic_col.object_id = ic.object_id and ic_col.column_id = ic.column_id where ic.object_id = idx.object_id and ic.index_id = idx.index_id and ic.is_included_column = 0 order by ic.key_ordinal for xml path('') ), 1, 1, '') as index_columns from sys.indexes idx where idx.object_id = object_id(#{tableName}) and idx.name is not null order by idx.index_id

select cast(obj.name as nvarchar(128)) as table_name, isnull(cast(tep.value as nvarchar(500)), '') as table_comment, cast(col.name as nvarchar(128)) as column_name, isnull(cast(cep.value as nvarchar(500)), '') as column_comment, cast(tp.name as nvarchar(128)) as data_type, case when col.max_length = -1 then -1 when tp.name in ('nvarchar', 'nchar', 'ntext') then col.max_length / 2 else col.max_length end as data_length, col.precision as data_precision, col.scale as data_scale, case when col.is_nullable = 1 then 'Y' else 'N' end as is_nullable, isnull(cast(dc.definition as nvarchar(500)), '') as column_default, case when col.is_identity = 1 then 'Y' else 'N' end as is_increment, case when exists ( select 1 from sys.indexes idx inner join sys.index_columns ic on ic.object_id = idx.object_id and ic.index_id = idx.index_id where idx.is_primary_key = 1 and ic.object_id = col.object_id and ic.column_id = col.column_id ) then 'Y' else 'N' end as is_pk, col.column_id as sort from sys.objects obj inner join sys.columns col on obj.object_id = col.object_id left join sys.types tp on col.user_type_id = tp.user_type_id left join sys.extended_properties tep on tep.major_id = obj.object_id and tep.minor_id = 0 and tep.name = 'MS_Description' left join sys.extended_properties cep on cep.major_id = col.object_id and cep.minor_id = col.column_id and cep.name = 'MS_Description' left join sys.default_constraints dc on dc.parent_object_id = col.object_id and dc.parent_column_id = col.column_id where obj.type = 'U' and obj.name != 'dtproperties'
and lower(cast(obj.name as varchar(128))) like lower(concat('%', #{dataDictTable.tableName}, '%'))
and lower(cast(tep.value as varchar(500))) like lower(concat('%', #{dataDictTable.tableComment}, '%'))
and obj.name in
#{tableNameItem}
order by obj.name, col.column_id
